criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Dark register throughout; a carefully modelled hero owning 1, 2, 7 and 9; 4 clean and bold. Short of the 10 on 8 (mannequins, the cite line on the near laptop), 3 (far lid moire, flat lawn), 9 (grey slabs behind the desk), 5 (mitten hand, flat sleeve) and 6 (desk small, grey-green lawn).

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck on the contact sheet; one hero, one key, the inlay changes state, the walk a spine; 8 declared; 5's sky slightly cooler.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every fact traces to a primary ACC page; 79 and fourteen computed; 'first-ever' held as the college's word. 'Two committees' a reading; slide 6 shows 13 pavers in frame.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where, when and the tension; what the policy governs stays general; slide 9 names no event, time or place and the form has no URL.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: 2 pays, 4 a real turn, 7 lands; the cover a label; 5 goes back after the turn; 6 and 8 overlap.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and local; the caption's closing question good; the disclaimers read as compliance notes; one designer's headline.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: First community college deck and a new instrument; familiar moves from nos. 46, 47 and 43.

one_sentence_fix: Make slide 9 the reader's actual next step, naming the October 22nd seminar's time and place, and put the form's URL in the first comment.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Low poly mannequins lit enough to read as dolls; the cite line on the near laptop.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Backlight the room so the figures are pure silhouettes; crop the hero laptop off the corner.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Moire on the middle and far lids; a flat lawn under stamped tufts.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Plain dim far lids; fog past the sixth row.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Grey slabs behind the desk read as a broken staircase.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera on the walk's axis or the out-of-pool pavers dropped below the light.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mitten hand and a flat black sleeve.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tighter crop to lit knuckles and a cuff; a rim from the lid along the sleeve.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Desk small; grey-green lawn; 13 pavers in frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back so all fourteen are in frame; the lawn outside the pool to near black.
